response.sql: WITH overall AS (SELECT AVG(amount - spent) AS overall_avg FROM budget WHERE amount IS NOT NULL AND spent IS NOT NULL) SELECT event_status AS status, AVG(amount - spent) AS average_left_over, AVG(amount - spent) - overall.overall_avg AS difference_from_overall_average FROM budget CROSS JOIN overall WHERE amount IS NOT NULL AND spent IS NOT NULL AND overall.overall_avg IS NOT NULL GROUP BY event_status
